title: Demuxlet Cell Preparation Protocol
author: Woong-Yang Park
materials: Leave around 200 µL of supernatant behind.

Keep the remaining cell suspension from individual samples On ice for DNA extraction using a QIAamp DNA Mini Kit (Qiagen, Cat no. 51306) according to the manufacturer’s protocol. Perform genotyping using Illumina Global Screening Array-24 v3.0 BeadChip (Cat. No.: 20030770).

steps.title: Prepare thawing media
steps.instruction: Prepare the appropriate volume of thawing media (RPMI + 5 % HS + 1 % Pen/Strep + 1 % Glutamine) and keep it at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare wash media
steps.instruction: Prepare the appropriate volume of wash media (RPMI + 10 % FBS + 1 % Pen/Strep + 1 % Glutamine) and keep it at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare PBS with BSA
steps.instruction: Prepare the appropriate volume of fresh PBS containing 0.04 % BSA.

steps.title: Warm all media to 37 °C
steps.instruction: Warm the thawing media, wash media, and PBS + 0.04 % BSA in a 37 °C water bath.

steps.title: Add thawing media to Falcon tubes
steps.instruction: Transfer 9 mL of 37 °C pre‑warmed thawing media into each 15 mL Falcon tube.

steps.title: Thaw cryovial of PBMCs
steps.instruction: Take the cryovial containing PBMCs out of liquid nitrogen, place it on dry ice, then transfer it immediately to the 37 °C water bath and thaw for 1 minute‑00:02:00 until no visible ice crystals remain.

steps.title: Add thawing media to cryovial
steps.instruction: In a biosafety cabinet, add 500 µL–1 mL of pre‑warmed thawing media to the cryovial using 1 mL wide‑bore blue tips.

steps.title: Transfer cells to Falcon tube
steps.instruction: Gently transfer the whole suspension from the cryovial into the 15 mL Falcon tube containing the 9 mL pre‑warmed thawing media using the same wide‑bore tips.

steps.title: Gently mix cell suspension
steps.instruction: Mix the suspension extremely gently by inverting the Falcon tube twice.

steps.title: Centrifuge cells first spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 300 × g, 21 °C for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Decant the supernatant.

steps.title: First wash: resuspend cells
steps.instruction: Using a serological pipette, gently resuspend the cell pellet 3–5 times in 5 mL of pre‑warmed wash media.

steps.title: Centrifuge after first wash
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 300 × g, 21 °C for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Decant leaving residual supernatant
steps.instruction: Decant the supernatant, leaving approximately 200 µL behind.

steps.title: Second wash: resuspend in PBS
steps.instruction: Using a serological pipette, gently resuspend the pellet 7 times in 3 mL of pre‑warmed PBS + 0.04 % BSA, avoiding bubbles.

steps.title: Centrifuge after second wash
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 300 × g, 21 °C for 5 minutes, then decant the supernatant leaving about 200 µL behind.

steps.title: Final resuspension in 800 µL PBS
steps.instruction: Gently resuspend the cells in 800 µL PBS + 0.04 % BSA, pipetting roughly 10 times.

steps.title: Filter cell suspension
steps.instruction: Filter the cell suspension through a 30 µm Macs SmartStrainer to remove clumps or debris; keep the filtrate on ice.

steps.title: Viability stain first sample
steps.instruction: Thoroughly mix 15 µL of the cell suspension with 15 µL trypan blue and load 10 µL of the mixture into each chamber of a cell counting slide.

steps.title: Incubate stain before counting
steps.instruction: Let the slide sit for 1 minute (00:01:00) before performing cell counting on an automated cell counter.

steps.title: Aliquot cells at 1.5 ×10⁶ cells/mL
steps.instruction: Make 100 µL aliquots of cells at a concentration of 1.50 × 10⁶ cells/mL for each sample.

steps.title: Pool samples for combined suspension
steps.instruction: Mix equal volumes (80 µL) of cell suspension from each sample (up to 16 samples) to obtain a pooled suspension with a final concentration of 1.50 × 10⁶ cells/mL (total volume 1280 µL) and keep it on ice.

steps.title: Viability stain pooled suspension
steps.instruction: Thoroughly mix 15 µL of the pooled suspension with 15 µL trypan blue and load 10 µL into each chamber of a cell counting slide.

steps.title: Incubate pooled stain before counting
steps.instruction: Let the pooled slide sit for 1 minute (00:01:00) before counting.

steps.title: Count pooled cells and verify concentration
steps.instruction: Count cells using an automated cell counter and verify that the concentration lies between 1.10 × 10⁶ and 1.50 × 10⁶ cells/mL.

steps.title: Load cells into 10x Chromium
steps.instruction: Load 40,000 cells per 10x well using the appropriate 10x reagent kit for your application and run the 10x Genomics Chromium Controller according to the manufacturer’s protocol.
